title: Legal entity identity and organization registry
workflow: Open organization party case with jurisdiction and legal form
Collect legal name, registrations, address and operating purpose
Cross-check documents against authorized source or reviewer
Record source dates, expiry and mismatch evidence
Link authorized officers and beneficial owners through separate relationships
Approve/reject organization identity before eligible customer activation
requirements: An unverified registration number is never accepted as proof of legal existence
Trade name cannot replace legal entity name or legal entity identifier
Registry status is time-bounded evidence and may be stale
Authorized signatory status and beneficial ownership are distinct relationships
Licensing for regulated corporate sectors requires separate source evidence
Organization records must be partitioned by institution and protected by legal privacy requirements
acceptance_tests: Same registration number in two jurisdictions is not automatically same entity
Expired authority to represent blocks restricted onboarding actions
Changing registered name leaves prior evidence and audit history
gate: Institution KYB policy, accepted registry evidence sources and qualified legal review.
